column3: The love of each one of you all is condensed to “your love.”
“In you” as the object of boasting is not expressed.
“Grant” and “This will take place” supply verbs.
The two groups marked by repeated those are combined into one description.
“Separated” supplies a verb to explain from the Lord’s presence.
The reason that the testimony was believed among you is rendered as “including you who have believed our testimony.”
“His” with calling and “your” with good desire are supplied.
